gotchas: Guest checkout works: search (/site/searchpage.jsp?st=…) -> 'Add to Cart' on a result (it navigates to /cart) -> 'Checkout' -> 'Continue as Guest'.

Checkout is one page with four numbered steps, each with its own 'Continue': 1 Contact info (email, phone), 2 Shipping address, 3 Shipping details (delivery-date radios, the cheapest pre-selected), 4 Payment method. Step 3 completed on its own after the address step.
State is a native <select> of two-letter codes (CA, TX, …), not names.
The address box offers suggestions (a 'Hide Suggestions' button); press Escape in the last address field before Continue.
Card number (#number), expiry (#expirationDate) and security code (#cvv) are plain inputs on the page, not in a payment iframe. The only iframe at the payment step is the PayPal button.
'Use as billing address' is pre-checked, so no separate billing form appears.
The card fields were probed read-only on 2026-10-06 and not filled (no card fill in this pass), so the card selectors are unverified.
The order total for an order.total hint was not settled: [data-testid*="total"] matches two elements and was reported unreadable.
Through the proxy from a US tunnel on 2026-10-06 no bot wall or challenge appeared on search, cart or checkout.

order.total: '[data-testid*="total" i]:last-of-type' resolves on the checkout page (checked 2026-10-09: 19.06 USD, and 12.65 USD on a second basket). '[data-testid*="total"]' alone matches two elements.
The search page can open a 'Choose a country' splash from a non-US egress. Adding &intl=nosplash to the URL skips it.

On 2026-10-09, after a few runs from one egress, 'Add to Cart' on search stopped adding: the cart stayed at 0 items and no cart request was sent. 'Checkout' on /cart was also blocked behind a .page-spinner overlay. That looks like soft bot throttling, so space runs out.
Identity tokens on this host (the email) wait for the owner's destination approval before anything is typed. On 2026-10-09 it was not granted, and the fill ended denied.
